description: This file defines a front-end UI component called 'NotesList' for a notes application, built with LightningJS. It manages displaying a list of notes, searching, creating new notes, and navigating through the list.

classes.name: NotesList
classes.description: A LightningJS component that renders a list of notes, with search and navigation features.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Reloads notes from the service and applies current filter.

methods.name: applyFilter
methods.description: Filters notes based on search query and updates focus.

methods.name: ensureOnSelect
methods.description: Ensures the currently focused item is selected and triggers onSelect callback.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Updates the search query and filters the list.

methods.name: createNew
methods.description: Creates a new note, refreshes the list, and sets focus on it.

methods.name: $rowColor
methods.description: Returns the background color for a row, highlighting the selected one.

methods.name: $rowAlpha
methods.description: Returns the alpha transparency for a row, highlighting the selected one.

methods.name: $time
methods.description: Formats an ISO date string into a human-readable 'Edited' timestamp.
